name: Quiruelas de Vidriales (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above with a yellow disc and yellow below with a green disc.
history: The municipal arms and flag were officially approved on 31 October 2002; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two triangles by the diagonal from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly corner, that at the hoist green with a yellow circle and that at the fly yellow with a green circle.
